# Theme contract

<!-- Generated by tools/theme-contract-reference.php from theme-interface. Don't edit by hand. -->

This page lists what a SightPress theme can rely on and must provide. It is generated from the `sightpress/theme-interface`
package. To build a theme step by step, follow the [Create a theme](../tutorials/create-a-theme.md) tutorial.

A theme is presentation only: design tokens, Twig templates, assets and translations. Anything with behaviour is a
module.

## theme.json

| Key | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Yes | The theme id; must equal the id in the theme's manifest. |
| `label` | Yes | Name shown to people. |
| `version` | Yes | The theme's version (Semantic Versioning); must equal the version in the theme's manifest. |
| `colors` | Yes | The colours for light and dark mode, and optionally for more contrast. |
| `typography` | Yes | Fonts and text sizes. |
| `spacing` | No | The spacing scale. |
| `radius` | No | Corner radii. |
| `focus` | No | The focus outline. |
| `contrast` | No | Colour pairs core checks in every colour mode: text needs 4.5:1, interface colours 3:1 (WCAG 2.2 AA). |
| `chart` | No | Which of the theme's colours the data series of a chart use, in order; without it they use chart-1 to chart-4. Core checks each series colour for 3:1 and chart-text for 4.5:1 on background and surface in every colour mode. |

## Token groups

Each group becomes CSS custom properties with this prefix.

| Group | Prefix |
| --- | --- |
| `typography` | `--font-` |
| `spacing` | `--space-` |
| `radius` | `--radius-` |
| `focus` | `--focus-` |

Charts use the colours `chart-1`, `chart-2`, `chart-3`, `chart-4`, `chart-grid`, `chart-text`.

## Layouts

| Id | Name | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | Default | Yes | One column at a comfortable reading width. |
| `home` | Home | Yes | An introduction band, then content at full page width. |
| `search` | Search results | Yes | The search form and the list of results. |
| `landing` | Landing | No | A wide introduction band, then content in full-width sections. |
| `sidebar` | Sidebar | No | Content with a side column for related links and notes. |
| `full-width` | Full width | No | Content across the whole page width, without a reading column. |

## Required templates

### master.html.twig

Page shell every page extends. Sets lang and dir on <html> from the page's language, includes the core <head> partial, makes "Skip to main content" the first thing to tab to, and has the landmarks <header>, <nav aria-label> for each menu and the language switcher, the site's <search> form (partials/search-form.html.twig, when search_action is set), <main id="content"> and <footer>. Shows messages at the top of <main> through partials/messages.html.twig. The <title> is document_title when set, else the title block and the site name, with "Error: " in front when the form has errors. Main menu items may have children, up to three levels, shown as nested lists that work without JavaScript.

Twig blocks: `title`, `head`, `brand`, `breadcrumbs`, `main`, `footer`, `scripts`.

| Variable | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `site_name` | `string` | No | The site's name. |
| `locale` | `string` | No | BCP 47 tag of the page's language; else current_locale(). |
| `document_title` | `string` | No | The whole <title>, when core sets it (SEO title, search results). |
| `home_url` | `string` | No | The home page in the page's language; else "/". |
| `branding_logo` | `array{url: string, alt: string, width: int, height: int}` | No | The uploaded logo, shown instead of the site's name in the header link. |
| `main_menu` | `list<array{label: string, url: string, current?: bool, children?: list<array<string, mixed>>}>` | No | Items of the main menu; current marks the page shown. |
| `footer_menu` | `list<array{label: string, url: string, current?: bool, children?: list<array<string, mixed>>}>` | No | Items of the footer menu. |
| `breadcrumbs` | `list<array{label: ?string, url: string}>` | No | Where the page is on the site, the last item the page itself; a null label is the home page. |
| `languages` | `list<array{code: string, name: string, url: string, current: bool}>` | No | The page in each published language, each named in its own language, for the language switcher; empty when there is only one. |
| `search_action` | `string` | No | Where the header's search form searches, while site search is on. |
| `messages` | `list<string>` | No | Messages to show once, such as "Page saved". |
| `form` | `array{errors: array<string, list<string>>}` | No | The form on the page, if any. |

### layouts/default.html.twig

One column at a comfortable reading width: the title, the lead, then the content.

Twig blocks: `content`.

| Variable | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | Yes | The page title, shown as the only <h1>. |
| `lead` | `string` | No | A short summary shown under the title. |
| `updated_at` | `DateTimeInterface` | No | When the page last changed (UTC), shown as "Last updated" with user_date in a <time datetime>. |

### layouts/home.html.twig

An introduction band with the title and lead, then the content at full page width.

Twig blocks: `hero`, `content`.

| Variable | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | Yes | The page title, shown as the only <h1>. |
| `lead` | `string` | No | A short summary shown under the title. |
| `updated_at` | `DateTimeInterface` | No | When the page last changed (UTC), shown as "Last updated" with user_date in a <time datetime>. |

### layouts/search.html.twig

Site search: the title as the only <h1> (what was searched for and how many results there are; core also puts it in <title>, so screen readers announce both when the page loads, without a live region), the search form, then the results as a numbered list (<ol start="first">), each with its title as a link in an <h2>, its trail and its extract with the matched words in <mark>. When nothing was found, nothing was searched for yet, or there were too many searches, the page says so in words, with tips.

Twig blocks: `content`.

| Variable | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | Yes | The heading, for example "3 results for “river”". |
| `query` | `string` | Yes | What was searched for; empty before a search. |
| `action` | `string` | Yes | Where the search form searches. |
| `state` | `'results'\|'none'\|'empty'\|'busy'` | Yes | results; none found; empty (nothing searched for yet); busy (too many searches, see retry_minutes). |
| `total` | `int` | Yes | How many results there are in all. |
| `first` | `int` | Yes | The number of the first result on this page. |
| `matched_all` | `bool` | Yes | False when no page has every word, so results have some of them. |
| `results` | `list<array{title: string, url: string, excerpt: string, locale: string, trail: string, extract: list<array{text: string, mark: bool}>}>` | Yes | The results on this page, best first; excerpt is plain text, extract the same text in pieces, mark true for matched words; trail is where the page is on the site. |
| `pagination` | `?array{current: int, pages: int, previous: ?string, next: ?string, pattern: string}` | Yes | Links to the other pages of results, or null; pattern is a sprintf() URL with %d for the page. |
| `language_name` | `string` | Yes | The name of the language searched, in that language. |
| `retry_minutes` | `?int` | Yes | Minutes to wait before searching again, when busy. |

### partials/messages.html.twig

Messages in a polite live region (role="status") that is always there, even when empty, so screen readers know it. Core's own views include it too.

| Variable | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `messages` | `list<string>` | Yes | The messages; may be empty. |

### partials/search-form.html.twig

A search form in a <search> landmark named by its visible label (aria-labelledby), with a search input named "q" and a visible "Search" button, sent with GET. Works the same without JavaScript. The shell and the search layout both include it, so its ids start with id.

| Variable | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `string` | Yes | URL the form is sent to with GET. |
| `query` | `string` | No | What was searched for, to fill the input. |
| `id` | `string` | No | Start of the form's ids, "search" by default, so a page can have two forms. |
| `label` | `string` | No | The visible label, "Search this site" by default. |

## Twig functions and filters

| Name | Kind | Use | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `asset` | function | `asset(string path): string` | URL of a file in the theme's assets/ folder, with its version in the name so it can be cached. The generated design tokens are at asset('tokens.css'). |
| `t` | function | `t(string message, array parameters = {}, string domain = 'messages'): string` | The message translated to the page's language; write messages in British English. |
| `can` | function | `can(string permission): bool` | Whether the person viewing the page has the permission on this site. |
| `csp_nonce` | function | `csp_nonce(): string` | The Content Security Policy nonce for this response, for the rare inline <script> or <style>. |
| `csrf_fields` | function | `csrf_fields(): string` | The hidden inputs that protect a POST form against cross-site request forgery (already escaped). |
| `current_locale` | function | `current_locale(): string` | The BCP 47 tag of the language the page is shown in, for example en-GB. |
| `text_direction` | function | `text_direction(string locale): string` | The writing direction of a language, "ltr" or "rtl", for the dir attribute. |
| `user_datetime` | filter | `user_datetime(?DateTimeInterface value, string style = 'medium'): string` | A date and time in the viewer's language and time zone; an empty string for null. |
| `user_date` | filter | `user_date(?DateTimeInterface value, string style = 'long'): string` | A date in the viewer's language and time zone; an empty string for null. |
